title: Answer a question about the code without changing anything
prompt: How long does the client wait before its 4th retry, in milliseconds? Work it out from the code (the README may be out of date). This is only a question: do not change any files.

stub.answer: The 4th retry waits 5000 ms: the backoff would be 250 * 3^3 = 6750 ms, but it is capped at capMs (5000).
